prompt:
Use case: logo-brand
Asset type: one square browser extension app icon concept for KeepXClean.
Primary request: explore the user's requested combination of SHIELD + x as a fresh independent brand mark.
Scene/backdrop: pure white opaque canvas. One flat, uniform very pale mint #EAF6EF rounded-square tile filling 94% of the image, corner radius approximately 22%. No gradient, texture or shadow on the mint tile.
Subject: a custom bold compact shield emblem centered on the tile, occupying about 61% of its height and 55% of its width. The shield has a calm broad slightly rounded horizontal top, gently curved shoulders, straight-ish tapering sides and one softly rounded bottom point. A filled, near-black titanium shield body, not an outline ring.
Inside the shield is a simple lowercase x cut out in the same pale mint color as the tile, centered slightly above the shield's geometric center. The x consists of two equally thick, short, rounded strokes crossing at right angles, giving a quiet symmetric small x. This x should be about 38% of shield width with plenty of solid dark shield around it. It is an ordinary geometric x / filtering symbol, NOT the social platform X logo: absolutely no long thin-and-thick diagonal combination, no double-line diagonal, no tall slanted X silhouette.
Style/medium: refined minimal brand icon, original custom silhouette, vector-friendly crisp edges, straight-on orthographic composition. Shield material is near-black charcoal titanium #171B1A with one restrained fine silver-gray edge highlight and very shallow relief. The badge should remain mostly matte black, not shiny chrome. Keep the x cutout flat mint without metal strokes.
Composition: exactly one icon, large comfortable negative space, strong silhouette readable at browser toolbar sizes. No text, no title, no watermark, no extra small previews, no mockup.
Avoid: official X/Twitter marks, Twitter bird, typography wordmarks, rings, protective orbit arcs, sparkles, stars, checkmarks, swords, heraldic ornaments, extra badges, cast shadows, glows, grain, mottled backgrounds, holes in the background, transparency checkerboards. Everything is opaque; outside the mint rounded tile is plain white.
